$description: Canonical token path <-> Pencil variable. Generated by tokens_to_pencil.py from tokens.json; do not hand-edit generated keys.

transforms.opacity/*: Pencil value = token $value × 100 (Pencil opacity variables are percent; literal node opacity is 0–1)

unsupported.size-binding: Pencil width/height cannot bind to number variables (they resolve to 0); spacing tokens are applied via padding/gap only.
unsupported.typography: Composite text styles are not Pencil variables; tokens are split into font.size / weight / letter-spacing / line-height and bound separately.
unsupported.shadow: Composite shadows are split into elevation.N.offset-y / blur (number) + color.semantic.elevation.N.color (themed colour).
